CREATE FUNCTION OM.FUNC_test (@id [varchar](30),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@process_date [datetime])
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT
		COUNT(*) CNT_SUCCESSFUL
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
	INNER JOIN
		[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS	
		ON
		OTR.STATUS_ID=OS.STATUS_ID
	WHERE
		OTR.TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name) AND
		OTR.PROCESS_DATE = @process_date AND 
		OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
);


CREATE TABLE D360.pvt (VendorID INT, Emp1 INT, Emp2 INT,  
    Emp3 INT, Emp4 INT, Emp5 INT);

INSERT INTO D360.pvt VALUES (4,4,2,5,5,4);  
INSERT INTO D360.pvt VALUES (5,5,1,5,5,5);  
GO  
-- Unpivot the table.  
SELECT VendorID, Employee, Orders  
FROM   
   (SELECT VendorID, Emp1, Emp2, Emp3, Emp4, Emp5  
   FROM D360.pvt) p  
UNPIVOT  
   (Orders FOR Employee IN   
      (Emp1, Emp2, Emp3, Emp4, Emp5)  
)AS unpvt;  
GO  




DECLARE @cols nvarchar(max)
SELECT --@cols = COALESCE(@cols + N',', N'') + 
QUOTENAME(c.name)
FROM syscolumns c
INNER JOIN sysobjects o ON c.id = o.id AND o.xtype = 'u'
WHERE o.name = 'MyTable' AND c.name NOT IN ('PID', 'UID')
ORDER BY c.colid

DECLARE @query nvarchar(max)
SELECT @query = N'
SELECT PID, [UID], Col AS ID, Val
FROM (
    SELECT PID, UID, ' + @cols + '
    FROM MyTable
    WHERE UID <> 0
) AS cp
UNPIVOT (
    Val FOR Col IN (' + @cols + ')
) AS up'

EXEC sp_executesql @query
